STEP_HINT.MODE: Free text through your WhatsApp, or approved Meta templates.
STEP_HINT.INBOX: The number the messages go out from.
STEP_HINT.MESSAGE: Variables, word variations and extra versions keep each message unique.
STEP_HINT.AUDIENCE: Labels and lists add people; smart segments narrow them down.
STEP_HINT.SAFETY: Pace, window and limits that protect the number.
STEP_HINT.SCHEDULE: Leave empty to start when you send.

MESSAGE.SEQUENCE_HINT: Each block is sent in order — mix text and media to build a sequence.
MESSAGE.TEXT_PLACEHOLDER: Type the message your contacts will receive…
MESSAGE.TEXT_HINT: Sent when there is no media attached.
MESSAGE.CAPTION: Caption (optional)
MESSAGE.TEMPLATE_EMPTY: No templates? Connect a Cloud API number to load approved templates.
MESSAGE.TEMPLATE_NO_INBOX: Set the inbox for this campaign to load its templates.

AUDIENCE.CONTACTS_HINT: {count} contacts — search by name or phone
AUDIENCE.CONTACTS_LOADED: {count} contacts loaded — scroll for more or search to filter
AUDIENCE.IMPORT_PLACEHOLDER: Paste phone numbers — one per line or separated by comma/semicolon.

SCHEDULE.HINT: Leave empty to send as soon as you launch.

PROGRESS.TITLE: Dispatch progress
PROGRESS.EMPTY: No recipients yet — messages will appear here as they go out.

SMART.VARIATIONS_NEED_TEXT: Write the message before asking for variations
SMART.TEMPLATE_NAME_PROMPT: Template name (it also becomes a canned response)
SMART.SPINTAX_HINT: Alternate words so no two messages are identical:
SMART.VARIANTS_HINT: Each contact gets one of the versions, at random.

SEGMENTS.TITLE: Smart segments
SEGMENTS.HINT: These narrow the audience. Alone, they filter all contacts; with labels or lists, they filter what those bring in.
SEGMENTS.EXCLUDE_LABELS: Leave out who has the label

SAFETY.HINT: Unofficial number: messages go out one at a time, at random intervals, only during business hours, within hourly and daily limits per connection. Opt-outs and customers being served are skipped, and the broadcast pauses itself if failures repeat.
SAFETY.QUIET_HOURS: Skip if talked in the last (h)
SAFETY.MAX_FAILURES: Pause after failures in a row
SAFETY.SMART_TIMING: Send at the time each contact usually replies
SAFETY.SMART_TIMING_HINT: Within the window. Contacts with no pattern get the normal pace; the broadcast may take an extra day.

EXCLUDED.OPTED_OUT: 1 asked not to receive — left out | {count} asked not to receive — left out
EXCLUDED.RECENT_ACTIVITY: 1 is talking to the salon now — left out | {count} are talking to the salon now — left out

PREVIEW.ESTIMATE: About {perHour}/hour and up to {perDay}/day, {start}h–{end}h: ~{days} day(s) to reach everyone.
PREVIEW.MISSING: 1 in the sample has an empty variable | {count} in the sample have an empty variable

SEQUENCES.SUBTITLE: Automatic messages tied to the customer's appointment (the "Schedule" in the customer sheet): reminder before, follow-up after. Every sequence starts OFF — turn it on only after reviewing the texts.
SEQUENCES.DIALOG_DESCRIPTION: Each step goes out relative to the appointment time, always within business hours. Saving does not turn it on.
SEQUENCES.ENABLE_CONFIRM: Turn on "{name}"? From the next appointments on, these messages go out automatically through the salon's number.
SEQUENCES.DISABLE_CONFIRM: Turn off "{name}"? Messages not sent yet are cancelled.
SEQUENCES.DELETE_CONFIRM: Delete "{name}"? Messages not sent yet are cancelled.
SEQUENCES.EMPTY: No sequences yet. Create a reminder for the day before the appointment, for example.

STATS.OPTED_OUT: 1 asked not to receive | {count} asked not to receive
